COUNT_CONFLICT: Two mails give different item counts, so the event goes to review.
COUNT_INVALID: The item count in a mail is not a number.
COUNT_MISSING: A mail has no item count.
ID_AMBIGUOUS: A mail names more than one shipment id.
ID_MISSING: A mail names no shipment id.
NO_LINES: A mail has no item lines.
PHYSMAIL_ANCHOR_INVALID: The Physical Mail anchor is not valid.
PHYSMAIL_EXPECT_INVALID: The expected-shipments setting is not valid.
PHYSMAIL_NO_STATE: No Physical Mail state is stored yet.
PHYSMAIL_STATE_SCHEMA: The stored state is not the expected schema.
SENDER_NOT_VENDOR: The sender is not a known vendor, so the mail is ignored.
SHIPMENT_STATE_MISSING: A mail has no shipment state.
SUBJECT_NOT_SCOPED: The subject is out of scope, so the mail is ignored.
UNBOUND_ITEM: A shipment item is not bound to a chain.
UNKNOWN_VERB: A mail uses an unknown verb.
VERB_AMBIGUOUS: A mail uses more than one verb.
WAITING_FOR_TRACKING: The shipment is waiting for a tracking number.
